checks.actual_compatibility: Original106432 and new109180 row schemas match exact helper identity/row schema. Max actual file290664032B fits1GiB. All observed identity fields nonnegative exact ints; zero file/link/absence conflicts, missing snapshot rows or duplicate selection.
checks.base_authentication: Held nofollow root/ancestor/file descriptors, ordinary bounded leaf, exact declared SHA and size, held/named identity and ancestor route checks. O_NONBLOCK prevents a swapped FIFO blocking initial leaf open.
checks.bounded_rejection: 180000 rows,1GiB/file,8GiB declared bytes,64MiB base/table/document; finite JSON depth/node/path bounds; duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite values, noncanonical paths and nonordinary identities fail closed.
checks.complete_typed_full_table: split requires every original row unchanged; expand rejects every overlap and verifies canonical SHA/count/total bytes with exact integer counters.
checks.exact_disjoint_delta: Authenticated base inputs.json retains its own current ordinary SHA/size/seven-field identity row in delta; base cannot contain itself or either representation key.
checks.focused_controls_source: 29 tiny-fixture methods cover all major validity/refusal paths, including post-EOF guard mutation for both split and expand. No helper or fixture execution by reviewer.
checks.metadata_preservation: JSON clone preserves every other field and list order, with no returned object aliases. Links, absences and snapshot selection remain complete fields; caller keeps their existing full guards.
checks.mutation_lifecycle: Context manager holds descriptors through parsing and both construction paths; final no-callback _unchanged_base runs during successful context exit before return.
checks.raw_document_vs_reconstruction: Consumers must bind actual compact JSON bytes separately, use expanded table for every payload check, and retain compact+base bytes and all selected proof payloads.

limits_of_review: Source/AST and read-only actual JSON catalog comparison only.
No imports, tests, controller/build/provider calls, new hash packet, compression measurement or capacity-fit qualification.
Caller integration and actual bounded control packet remain separate review scopes.
Future fixture harness must narrowly admit owned nofollow directory traversal, while keeping external file reads restricted.

resolved_finding.resolution: Descriptors retained through construction with final no-callback check; test_guard_mutation_after_read_is_rejected_before_return added.
